meta.description: Net-new events merged during this refresh. Window: 2026-10-12 to 10-17. A heavy week: Deloitte launched Risk Clarity (AI-native risk management via its Ascend platform, 10-14) and a Sirion alliance for AI-powered contract lifecycle management (10-15); Accenture announced a forward deployed engineering program with Workday for the agentic AI era (10-13), acquired Sagacity Solutions for AI-driven customer intelligence (10-13), and partnered with UMass Memorial Health and Microsoft on AI-powered healthcare innovation (10-15); BCG published The AI-First Tech Function (10-13) and showcased Fabriq Personalization AI by BCG X (10-14); KPMG released its US CEO Outlook 2026 (10-15); Capgemini broke four quiet rounds with an agentic AI governance report in automotive (10-12); L.E.K. published a humanoid robotics / physical AI piece (10-14). EY and PwC had no in-window signals. Coverage caveat: the web-search provider remained down all week; Deloitte, Accenture, KPMG, PwC, EY, and Capgemini were swept via their newsrooms in a browser, while Bain (Cloudflare), McKinsey (Akamai), and Oliver Wyman Forum (no dates) remain unverified for this window. FTI, Alvarez & Marsal, Kearney, and Roland Berger were not individually re-swept this round.

events.title: Deloitte 发布 Risk Clarity：AI-native 风险管理平台（经 Ascend 交付）
events.title_en: Deloitte launches Risk Clarity to modernize risk management with AI-powered intelligence
events.summary: Deloitte 于 2026-10-14（纽约）发布 Risk Clarity，一个帮助企业加速企业风险全生命周期的 AI-native 解决方案，通过 agentic 能力实现，并经 Deloitte 的 AI 注入交付平台 Ascend 交付。这是 Deloitte 继 M&A Platform 之后本月第二个平台级 AI 产品。
events.summary_en: On October 14, 2026, Deloitte launched Risk Clarity, an AI-native solution that helps organizations accelerate the enterprise risk lifecycle through agentic capabilities, delivered through Ascend, Deloitte's AI-infused service delivery platform — its second platform-level AI product this month after the M&A Platform.

events.title: Accenture 与 Workday 启动 forward deployed engineering 计划，重塑 agentic AI 时代的工作
events.title_en: Accenture launches forward deployed engineering program with Workday to reinvent work for the agentic AI era
events.summary: Accenture 于 2026-10-13（纽约）宣布与 Workday 合作启动联合 forward deployed engineering（FDE）计划，帮助组织在 AI 时代重新设计工作方式，把 FDE 模式延伸到 HR、财务与 IT 场景。这是 Accenture 本月第二个 FDE 相关动作（前有 Google Cloud 千人 FDE 团队）。
events.summary_en: On October 13, 2026, Accenture and Workday announced a joint forward deployed engineering (FDE) program to help organizations reinvent how work gets done in the age of AI, extending the FDE model into HR, finance, and IT scenarios.

events.title: Deloitte 与 Sirion 结成战略联盟，交付 AI 驱动的合同生命周期管理
events.title_en: Deloitte and Sirion launch strategic alliance for AI-powered contract lifecycle management
events.summary: Deloitte 于 2026-10-15 宣布与合同生命周期管理厂商 Sirion 结成战略联盟，交付 AI 驱动的 CLM 解决方案，提升可见性、合规与企业价值。这是 Deloitte 在法务/合同 AI 场景的最新生态绑定。
events.summary_en: On October 15, 2026, Deloitte and Sirion announced a strategic alliance to deliver AI-powered contract lifecycle management solutions that enhance visibility, compliance, and enterprise value.

events.title: UMass Memorial Health 携手 Accenture 与 Microsoft 推进 AI 医疗创新
events.title_en: UMass Memorial Health announces AI-powered innovation initiative with Accenture and Microsoft
events.summary: Accenture 于 2026-10-15 宣布 UMass Memorial Health 与 Accenture、Microsoft 的多年期合作：统一数据平台以提升医疗服务与运营并驱动 AI 创新。这是 Accenture 医疗 AI 方向的最新客户落地。
events.summary_en: On October 15, 2026, Accenture announced a multi-year initiative between UMass Memorial Health, Accenture, and Microsoft to modernize the health system's data platform and drive AI-powered innovation in care delivery and operations.

events.title: BCG 发布《The AI-First Tech Function》：CEO 需要知道的 AI 优先技术职能
events.title_en: BCG publishes The AI-First Tech Function: what CEOs need to know
events.summary: BCG 于 2026-10-13 发布面向 CEO 的 AI-first 技术职能研究，讨论 CTO/CIO 如何为 agentic AI 做准备、重构技术组织的定位与运作，延续其 agentic AI 组织层研究线。
events.summary_en: On October 13, 2026, BCG published research for CEOs on building the AI-first tech function, covering how CTOs and CIOOs should prepare for agentic AI and reposition the technology organization.

events.title: Capgemini 发布汽车业 agentic AI 治理报告：68% 试用，仅 5% 治理成熟
events.title_en: Capgemini report: 68% of automotive organizations use or pilot agentic AI for product development, but only 5% report mature AI governance
events.summary: Capgemini 于 2026-10-12 发布汽车业研究报告：68% 的汽车组织正在产品开发中使用或试点 agentic AI，但仅 5% 报告拥有成熟的 AI 治理。这是 Capgemini 连续四轮沉寂后的首个 AI 净新增，直击 agentic AI 规模化的治理缺口。
events.summary_en: On October 12, 2026, Capgemini published an automotive sector report finding 68% of organizations use or pilot agentic AI for product development while only 5% report mature AI governance — Capgemini's first AI signal after four quiet rounds, highlighting the governance gap in agentic AI scaling.

events.title: Accenture 收购 Sagacity Solutions，扩展 AI 驱动的客户智能
events.title_en: Accenture acquires Sagacity Solutions to scale AI-driven customer intelligence across Accenture Song's UK & Ireland operations
events.summary: Accenture 于 2026-10-13（伦敦）宣布收购英国数据与客户智能公司 Sagacity Solutions，增强 Accenture Song 规模化交付 AI 驱动客户重塑的能力，回应客户把数据、AI 与运营整合为成果导向项目的需求。
events.summary_en: On October 13, 2026, Accenture acquired Sagacity, a UK-based data and customer intelligence firm, strengthening Accenture Song's capacity to deliver AI-powered customer reinvention at scale.

events.title: KPMG 发布 2026 美国 CEO 展望：对 AI 进展有信心，但网络与地缘风险加剧
events.title_en: KPMG US 2026 CEO Outlook: CEOs confident in AI progress amid intensifying cyber and geopolitical risks
events.summary: KPMG 于 2026-10-15 发布 2026 美国 CEO Outlook：美国 CEO 对自身 AI 进展和美国经济有信心，但网络安全与地缘风险在加剧、通胀压力仍在。这是 KPMG 年度 CEO 调研的 AI 叙事更新。
events.summary_en: On October 15, 2026, KPMG released its US CEO Outlook 2026, finding US CEOs confident in their AI progress and the strength of the US economy while cybersecurity and geopolitical risks intensify and inflation pressures persist.

events.title: BCG X 发布 Fabriq 个性化 AI 平台资产
events.title_en: BCG X releases Fabriq Personalization AI
events.summary: BCG 于 2026-10-14 在 BCG X 产品库发布 Fabriq Personalization AI 平台资产，面向实时客户时刻的营销个性化，是 BCG X 连续两周的产品化输出（前有 Frontline Ops AI）。
events.summary_en: On October 14, 2026, BCG X added Fabriq Personalization AI to its product library, a platform asset for meeting every customer in the moment — BCG X's second productized output in as many weeks after Frontline Ops AI.

events.title: L.E.K. 发布人形机器人研究：物理 AI 的价值可能在哪里积累
events.title_en: L.E.K. publishes Humanoid Robotics: assessing where value may accrue in physical AI
events.summary: L.E.K. 于 2026-10-14 发布人形机器人与物理 AI 研究，评估物理 AI 价值链上价值可能积累的环节，延续其从软件 AI 向物理 AI 延伸的覆盖。
events.summary_en: On October 14, 2026, L.E.K. published research on humanoid robotics, assessing where value may accrue in physical AI, extending its coverage from software AI into physical AI.
